title: dianthus caryophyllus f. transiens
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus f. transiens, commonly known as the 'Clove Pink', is a variety of fragrant pink carnation plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce pain, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus caryophyllus f. transiens include its ability to act as an expectorant, a carminative, and an anti-emetic, helping to relieve respiratory issues, digestive problems, and nausea. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its fragrance and therapeutic effects.
